name: Elisabeth
summary: A woman descended from Aaron, married to the priest Zacharias, who had no children into old age. God gave her a son, John, and when Mary visited, she was filled with the Holy Ghost and blessed her.

key_moments.title: Righteous but Childless
key_moments.description: Elisabeth and her husband Zacharias were both righteous before God and kept all His commandments. But they had no child, because Elisabeth was barren, and both were old.

key_moments.title: A Son in Old Age
key_moments.description: After the angel's promise to Zacharias, Elisabeth became pregnant and stayed hidden for five months. She said the Lord had taken away her shame among people.

key_moments.title: The Baby Leaped
key_moments.description: When Mary greeted her, the baby leaped inside Elisabeth and she was filled with the Holy Ghost. She called Mary blessed among women and the mother of her Lord.

key_moments.title: Naming Her Son John
key_moments.description: Elisabeth gave birth to a son, and her neighbours rejoiced with her. When they wanted to name him after his father, she said he would be called John.
